t: Garlands are very similar to lights. They have the same shape placements as Classic/Mini lights, with the exception of the Cap shape, as a horizontal works for a peak. They come in three styles: $(li)Plain $(li)White lights $(li)Multi Lights
花环与灯具极为相似。其摆放造型与经典/迷你灯具一致（封顶型除外，因水平型已适用于峰顶）。共提供三种样式：$(li)素色款 $(li)白色灯款 $(li)多彩灯款
Horizontal garlands will connect in and around corners, just like the lights.
水平花环可在角落内外自然连接，如同灯具一般。
Diagonal garlands will extend slightly under their placement, similar to Icicle Lights. This is done so that they line up with eachother better.
对角线花环在放置时会略微向下延伸，类似冰凌灯。此举旨在使它们彼此对齐效果更佳。
Vertical Garland will line up with the left or right side of a block.
竖直花环将与方块的左侧或右侧对齐。
Vertical Corner Garland will create two sections of garland at a 90 degree angle, lining up with the left side or right side of a block.
竖直转角花环将在90度夹角处形成两段花环，分别与方块的左侧或右侧对齐。

You'll start by crafting a Horizontal Garland.$(br2)To craft this, you'll need three spruce leaves and two bows.$(br2)You will also need a template for the other shapes of garland, just like you did for the lights. Read on for the recipes...
你将首先合成水平花环。$(br2)合成所需材料为3个云杉树叶与2张弓。$(br2)其余造型的花环同样需要模板，正如灯具所需。更多配方请继续阅读……

To create the lit versions of the garlands, combine a horizontal garland with the 'Tree' light of your choice in a crafting table.$(br2)To make other shapes, combine 3 garlands with a template in a crafting table, as shown here:
要制作亮灯版本的花环，请在工作台中将水平花环与你选择的“树形”灯具组合。$(br2)要制作其他造型，请在工作台中将3个花环与对应模板组合，具体如图所示：
